positions.title: Georgia Tech Computer Science, Bachelor of Science [completed Fall 2019]
positions.description:
BSCS[Projects]
•Capstone/Full-Stack App(Team sponsor: Honeywell) (see CV for GitHub Links)
[1]Goal: improve delivery of digital NOTAMs(Notices to Airmen) 
[2]Algo's picked according to data-type scraped+parsed 
[3]Data JSON-string-tokenized prior to DB indexing, optimizing elapsed time from query to start of front-end rendering
[4]Query time to data rendering improved >75% in final set of unit tests, compared to 1st MVP iteration
[5]Back-End w/Spring Boot+Postgres & Angular(TypeScript) front-end
[7]CQRS arch included in design of future iterations of app for optimized responsiveness, with design to include NoSQL DB for improved handling of data+implementation of circular-queue, for enqueuing of parsed data & dequeuing of data during DB indexing

•Sonification UI Dev: (see CV Link)
[1]Lie Detector w/C#/Unity/Adobe Audition
[2]8-Track Player w/C#/Unity

•Computer Vision: (see CV Link)
[1]Gaussian & Laplacian Pyramids for image blending w/Python/Numpy/SciPy
[2]Single image rendering of multiple images X multiple subjects w/OpenCV/Python
[3]Feature Matching w/SIFT/OpenCV/Python
[4]Haar feature-based cascade classifiers for face detection in intra-image face swapping app
[5]Refactored OpenCV API C++ code & associated Python bindings and header parser scripts, if customization improved rendering

•RDB Dev for Library Web App: (see CV Link)
[1]RDB-schema design, initially visualized w/ER diagram
[2]App simulated GT library server & UI 
[3]NodeJS for back-end w/MySQL DB
[4]Rapid prototyping of app's UI w/Bootstrap

•Android Mobile App Dev: (see CV Link)
[1]Rat-population monitoring app to assist NYC w/tracking rat sightings.
[2]Mobile app coded in Java w/Firebase DB
[3]Test-driven dev w/JUnit
[4]GitHub for VC & ZenHub plug-in for team management
[5]SDLC designs modeled w/Visual Paradigm

•Java Full-Stack App/JavaFX/Spring Boot/MySQL:
[1]Coded desktop game
[2]~30 classes
[3]MVC arch for scalable/maintainable code base
[4]Spring Boot back-end
[5]MySQL DB 
[6]JavaFX front-end

positions.title: Senior Relationship Manager
positions.description:
600 North Congress Ave
Boynton Beach, FL 33426

•	Customer-facing sales & marketing strategies pitched to bank executives.
•	Project & Personnel Management
•	Account Sales, Software Integration, &
Interdepartmental Collaboration
•	Consistently delivered results in the top 1% of the company's project managers.
•	Software design & development experience.
•	Focus on UX research as a requirement for creating successful software applications.
•	Sales with emphasis on deposits, commercial and residential loan acquisition as primary strategies to increase the profitability of the branch.
•	Prospecting, development of banking relationships with local businesses, and client referrals helped generate more than $450,000 in commercial loan closings, projected to earn $30,000 in residual annual income for the branch.
•	2nd ranked in sales for the first quarter of 2009 out of all employees engaging in sales activities in Florida with 1 million+ in retail loans closed. 
•	28th ranked in sales for the second quarter of 2010 out of all employees engaging in sales activities in RBC Bank’s six-state footprint. 	
•	Organized presentations for owners of local businesses, not-for-profit groups, and their employees to stimulate the growth of our client base.
